title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2608.24876v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) remains hard in long-horizon tasks, where growing histories obscure the task state and misalign skill invocation. We introduce Recuris, a recursive Experiential-Working Memory architecture for long-horizon agent harnesses, in which Working Memory tracks task progress and guides skill selection from Experiential Memory, grounding skill use in current needs rather than the full history. This coupling also turns execution into structured evidence that localizes failures to specific memory components. Across tasks, a fixed Meta-Agent turns that evidence into localized, validation-gated updates to Skill Memory that reshape execution and yield new evidence, forming a bounded recursive memory-evolution loop. Across four long-horizon benchmarks and ten models, Recuris improves task success in 35 of the 37 completed model-benchmark pairs, carrying frontier models to SOTA-level task success: on tau-bench it adds +1

translated_title: 递归经验-工作记忆演化用于长程智能体框架
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）在长程任务中仍然困难，因为不断增长的历史记录模糊了任务状态并导致技能调用错位。我们引入了Recuris，一种用于长程智能体框架的递归经验-工作记忆架构，其中工作记忆跟踪任务进度并从经验记忆中选择技能，将技能使用基于当前需求而非完整历史。这种耦合还将执行转化为结构化证据，将失败定位到特定的记忆组件。跨任务中，一个固定的元智能体将这些证据转化为针对技能记忆的局部化、验证门控更新，重塑执行并产生新证据，形成有界的递归记忆演化循环。在四个长程基准和十个模型上，Recuris在37个完成的模型-基准对中提升了35个的任务成功率，将前沿模型推向SOTA级任务成功率：在tau-bench上增加了+1。
tldr: 本文提出Recuris递归经验-工作记忆架构，通过将执行转化为结构化证据并驱动局部化记忆更新，在长程任务中显著提升智能体成功率，实现有界的递归自我改进。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Recuris, a recursive experiential-working memory architecture that converts execution into structured evidence to drive localized memory updates, significantly improving agent success rates in long-horizon tasks via bounded recursive self-improvement.
